title: How to Add a Custom Font to Your Shopify Theme
description:
Upload your own font to Shopify and apply it to your theme with a Custom Liquid section. Works for every UTD theme.

YouTube doesn't allow code in descriptions, so the code is in our guide:
• Victory: https://utd-docs.helpscoutdocs.com/article/28-add-custom-fonts#Pay-attention-XPIHI
• Gain, Boutique, Ultra, Allure, Impression, Fuse: https://utd-docs.helpscoutdocs.com/article/28-add-custom-fonts#-dSA9l

All UTD themes in the official Shopify Theme Store:
